question: What is KALYANKJIL's CEO paid, and how has that changed in three years?
answer: KALYANKJIL's CEO/Managing Director is Mr. T.S. Kalyanaraman. Per the annual reports: FY25 (AR FY25) total remuneration ₹112.76 million (basic salary ₹112.76M, no perquisites/commission/ESOP/incentive) plus AED 402,000 from Kalyan Jewellers FZE. The prior year figure (FY24-era AR, labelled "FY 2025-26") shows ₹111.74 million total. So over the period the pay stayed essentially flat (~₹111.7–112.8M), a marginal increase of ~0.9%. FY26 executive-director remuneration detail is not separately broken out in the held data (only aggregate FY2025-26 wages/median figures).
working: FY25 AR (known 2025-08-14): 'Details of remuneration paid to the Executive Directors for the FY25' → Mr. T.S. Kalyanaraman Managing Director Total 112.76 (₹ million). FY24 AR (known 2024-07-24): Executive Directors 'financial year 2025-26' → Total 111.74 (₹ million). AED 402,000 subsidiary pay noted in FY25 AR.
missing: FY26-specific CEO remuneration breakdown not separately stated in held annual report chunks (only aggregate FY2025-26 wages/median figures available).

args.answer: KALYANKJIL's CEO/Managing Director is Mr. T.S. Kalyanaraman. Per the annual reports: FY25 (AR FY25) total remuneration ₹112.76 million (basic salary ₹112.76M, no perquisites/commission/ESOP/incentive) plus AED 402,000 from Kalyan Jewellers FZE. The prior year figure (FY24-era AR, labelled "FY 2025-26") shows ₹111.74 million total. So over the period the pay stayed essentially flat (~₹111.7–112.8M), a marginal increase of ~0.9%. FY26 executive-director remuneration detail is not separately broken out in the held data (only aggregate FY2025-26 wages/median figures).
args.missing: FY26-specific CEO remuneration breakdown not separately stated in held annual report chunks (only aggregate FY2025-26 wages/median figures available).
args.working: FY25 AR (known 2025-08-14): 'Details of remuneration paid to the Executive Directors for the FY25' → Mr. T.S. Kalyanaraman Managing Director Total 112.76 (₹ million). FY24 AR (known 2024-07-24): Executive Directors 'financial year 2025-26' → Total 111.74 (₹ million). AED 402,000 subsidiary pay noted in FY25 AR.
